name: codex-server-tasks
description: Run Codex tasks on your own Linux server after the desktop disconnects.

interface.shortDescription: Run, monitor, and resume Codex tasks on your server
interface.longDescription: Use the existing Codex app to submit independent server tasks, recover saved events and results, and continue a server-side Codex session. Requires a Linux server with Codex CLI, Python and a persistent systemd user manager.
defaultPrompt: Use $server-tasks to run this task on the server in the background and return its job ID.
